text:
maria_infra: Heads up — seeing persistent p99 encode latency from small tenants on eu-edge (eu-warm-01). GPU util looks normal but NIC tx queue depth is pegged and we're seeing packet drops -> higher tail latency.
aj: ugh. any recent config changes?
maria_infra: No config rollouts. Telemetry shows steady rise starting ~09:12UTC. NVMe and HBM fine. tcptracer shows long egress bursts from a handful of pods.
kevin_sre: can you paste the top talkers?
maria_infra: top talkers from flow-agg: tenant-a (40%), tenant-c (22%), tenant-q (18%), system-p2p (8%), remainder small. Most traffic is small token-by-token RPCs causing IRQ storms.
tilly: is this noisy neighbor on NIC or on top-of-rack switch? which queue?
maria_infra: nic queue 3 (tx) per-host saturating. switch counters show large egress burst per host >700kpps for seconds at a time.
aj: idea: temporarily repartition egress slots and move low-priority tenants to a dedicated quiet slice while we diagnose. reduces tail for everyone.
kevin_sre: prefer we avoid manual host changes. Could we do a routing shim: pin busy tenants to preemptible slices that have different QoS tags?
tilly: we have fractional dedicated slices we can shove tenants into, but need to ensure reserved-capacity billing doesn't explode.
sam_product: note cost implications — shifting into more reserved slices ups committed spend. Preemptible reduces unit cost but hurts predictability for some customers.
maria_infra: Proposal: 1) create a temporary 'egress-quiet' slice on eu-warm AZ with NIC shaping at 10G for noisy tenants; 2) reroute token-chattier tenants to that slice with lower SLA; 3) monitor p99 over 30m and rollback if no improvement.
kevin_sre: +1 on monitoring, but can we do a soft-redirect first? set route weight 0.2 to quiet slice so 20% of new connections go there, see impact.
aj: sounds safe. how to enact?
maria_infra: quick commands:
```bash
# label tenants for routing
kubectl annotate tenant tenant-a inference-routing=egress-quiet
# adjust scheduler weight (api)
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \ 
  https://scheduler.internal/api/v1/routes/weights \ 
  -d '{"slice":"egress-quiet","weight":0.2,"region":"eu"}'
```
aj: nice. opsbot, create a temporary incident tracker for this and add paging for SRE if p99 > 200ms for 10m?
opsbot: Incident created: INC-2026-4392 "eu-edge egress queue tail" — paging threshold set p99>200ms 10m.
kevin_sre: also add an eBPF NIC counter probe on the hosts to capture per-pod tx bursts.
maria_infra: already pushed probe to eu-warm-01 -> collecting per-pod ring occupancy and irq rates.
tilly: timeline?
maria_infra: will flip 20% traffic now, observe for 15m, then 50% if stable. If p99 drops >30% we proceed to full mover.
aj: if this fixes it, follow-up action: automated detection + soft-redirect policy so we avoid manual runs.
sam_product: and product will notify affected tenants on lower SLA about potential preemptions if we cut them over.
kevin_sre: short term mitigation approved. long term: need NIC queue fairness and per-tenant pacing upstream in proxy to avoid pps spikes.
maria_infra: agreed. I'll post a playbook draft after we stabilize. thanks team :thumbsup:
aj: thanks — ping when you push to 50%
maria_infra: pinged. 20% on, initial 15m window started at 09:38UTC.
opsbot: Alert suppressed for 5m while mitigation in progress.
maria_infra: 09:50UTC update: p99 for small tenants dropped from 420ms -> 260ms with 20% routing. per-host nic queue depth down ~45%.
kevin_sre: good signal. proceed to 50% when ready. remember to capture billing delta for reserved vs preemptible usage.
maria_infra: moving to 50% now.
tilly: recording runbook step: "egress-quiet soft-redirect"
sam_product: will draft customer comms.
maria_infra: final note: if we see oscillation after scaling to 50% we may need to shard the slice across AZs rather than concentrate it in eu-warm. planning will follow.
